name: search-test-set
description: Roadmap S3.9: realistic typed searches with their correct result. expect = answer (must be answered with exactly this composition), choice (answered with it, or offered among the choices), none (must not be answered). The composition key of each case comes from the brand database by `brand` (exact name) or from the Jan Aushadhi list by `ja` (drug code), never written by hand. Built by evals/build_search_cases.mjs into evals/search_cases.json.
